name: NVIDIA Granary v2 (multilingual speech labels)
summary: Open multilingual speech-recognition and speech-translation label set from NVIDIA: 48 languages, 16 source corpora, labels for ~463k hours (~165k h high-quality), plus ~92k h X→en and ~39k h en→X translation pairs. Used to train Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe; useful for fine-tuning ASR/AST models with NeMo. Label manifests only, audio comes from the original corpora.

access.notes: Ungated HF repo. Labels are OpenMDW-1.1, people_speech subset CC BY-SA 4.0. Contains label manifests only: source audio must be obtained from each distributor under its own terms (some gated, e.g. Common Voice, IMDA NSC).

procedure: Open https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Granary-v2 and read the License and Hours-by-corpus tables
Download the label manifests: hf download nvidia/Granary-v2 --repo-type dataset (or load with the datasets library)
Obtain the source audio for the corpora you need from their distributors, as listed in the README 'Getting the audio' section
Check each source corpus license before commercial use

stats.size: ~112 GB of compressed JSONL manifests (labels only)

verdict.why: Official NVIDIA release, ungated, permissive label license and very large multilingual coverage. Not a direct gamedev asset, and the audio must be gathered separately under mixed upstream licenses, so commercial use depends on the corpora chosen.
